content:
anna-peopleops: Quick heads-up — planning a small 'Recognition Cafe' pop-up next Wed 11/8, hybrid (SF + virtual). Idea: drop-in nomination station + sticker wall + remote swag kits. Want a few volunteers for shifts 11–2. Sign-up form + QR will be live.
lia-culture: Love it! I can cover 11–12 in the SF office.
sam-engineering: I can do 12–1, will bring extra sticker sheets.
jordan-hr: Heads up — need to confirm budget for $300 catering + ~$150 for kits. @kevin-recruiting can you estimate shipping for ~20 kits?
kevin-recruiting: Yep, I'll check UPS/USPS rates. Do we have a list of addresses or will folks fill form? I'll DM for details.
anna-peopleops: Budget note — we have $600 earmarked for Q4 culture ops. If shipping >$150 we'll pivot to digital gift cards.
matt-ops: Facility note: need room setup request 48h before. What's expected turnout? Last pop-up was ~40.
lia-culture: Let's plan for 50 hybrid to be safe; can set up overflow in lounge.
kudos-bot: New nomination submitted by sam-engineering — "Anna made onboarding docs so much clearer" :tada: 
anna-peopleops: lol thanks @sam — saving that for the spot-award shortlist :smile: 
lia-culture: Volunteers checklist so far: Anna (host), Lia (co-host), Sam (sticker station), Priya (virtual mod).
priya-support: I'll run the virtual table, monitor the form and Slack threads.
jordan-hr: Quick policy Q — can managers nominate their directs? Policy allows it but panel members deciding awards must recuse if they nominated.
anna-peopleops: Confirmed — managers can nominate; recusal required for the decision panel.
lia-culture: Decision panel volunteers: Maria, Jordan, Kevin?
maria-ops: I can be on the panel.
kevin-recruiting: I'm in.
anna-peopleops: Final checklist (EOD Fri sign-up deadline): 1) order 50 sticker sheets (Lia) 2) create QR + form (Anna) 3) order kits or digital cards (Kevin) 4) room booking (Matt) 5) panel confirmed (Maria/Jordan/Kevin). Sign-up sheet: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1xyz
sam-engineering: Adding my name to the sheet now.
anna-peopleops: Thanks — I'll send calendar invites and a pulse nudge tomorrow :pray: 
kevin-recruiting: Will post shipping estimate in the sheet by Thurs.
anna-peopleops: FYI we'll announce winners on the following Monday town hall.
lia-culture: Yay :confetti_ball: 
anna-peopleops: Tagging @here for visibility — if anyone else wants to volunteer reply here and I'll slot you in.
